approval_reason: User explicitly authorized the Runtime Feedback executable backlog.

release.approval_reason: User accepted the Runtime Feedback milestone after reviewing its Definition of Done evidence and residual risks.

scope_approval_reason: User accepted BA-REQ-MDS-FEEDBACK-001@0.1.0 and its evidence-only boundary.

excluded: Git write operations and pull-request mutation

tasks.title: Approve the read-only feedback scope and requirement
acceptance_criteria: Human authority accepts the evidence-only boundary, acceptance criteria and explicit exclusions.
The approved version preserves the MDS/Implementation Plane separation.
risks: Scope is approved; implementation remains blocked by the architecture and backlog gates.

tasks.title: Approve the evidence bundle and finding architecture contract
acceptance_criteria: The ADR defines bundle identity, hashes, source references, storage, audit and replay behavior.
Path traversal, tampering, staleness and producer mismatch fail closed.
risks: No real producer sample has been approved yet; the accepted contract may require a versioned successor.

tasks.title: Import and preserve one bounded evidence bundle
acceptance_criteria: A valid bundle is copied byte-for-byte, checksummed, registered and auditable under the runtime project.
Import is idempotent and never writes to the managed project.
risks: Unbounded bundle parsing could create path, archive or memory vulnerabilities.

tasks.title: Reject unsafe, tampered, stale and mismatched evidence
acceptance_criteria: Traversal, checksum mismatch, oversized input, stale identity and unknown context fixtures fail closed.
Failures retain bounded audit evidence without accepting the bundle.
risks: Filesystem and timestamp semantics differ across platforms.

tasks.title: Correlate evidence with truth and implementation context
acceptance_criteria: Correlation retains artifact, version, context package, producer and commit/build identity.
Missing or non-authoritative references cannot become trusted findings.
risks: Loose identity mapping could attach evidence to the wrong approved head.

tasks.title: Project deterministic verification findings for human review
acceptance_criteria: Passing, missing, stale and mismatch outcomes are deterministic and evidence-backed.
Findings start DRAFT and do not auto-promote truth or release state.
risks: A misleading pass classification could create false confidence.

tasks.title: Deliver desktop evidence and finding review interactions
acceptance_criteria: A human can inspect evidence identity, source references, linked artifact/version and finding status.
Renderer consumes typed application operations; authority and security policy remain outside React.
risks: Browser click-through automation availability is not yet confirmed.

tasks.title: Produce fresh Runtime Feedback Definition of Done evidence
acceptance_criteria: One external evidence bundle completes intake, correlation, finding and human review without managed-source mutation.
Fresh build, validators, security tests, integration tests, smoke, residual risks and release gate are recorded.
